summary: BitFuFu Inc., a Singapore-domiciled NASDAQ-listed Bitcoin miner, furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) carrying an Exhibit 99.1 press release on October 2026 Bitcoin production and operational metrics. Disclosed figures: 1,454 BTC held (up 4.8% from 1,388), 137 BTC produced (67 self-mining, 70 cloud), total hashrate under management 19.5 EH/s versus 19.4 in September, fleet efficiency 16.3 J/TH, and 317 MW managed power capacity. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is stated. Watch mining economics as network difficulty rose roughly 11.8% during October.
